Twi-Laq Industries operates in the Retail Office Equipment sector, supplying and manufacturing cleaning products and related supplies. Based in Bronx, New York, the company serves institutional clients such as New York City Housing and the Board of Education, indicating a focus on large, organization-wide procurement and ongoing maintenance needs rather than consumer retail. With a long-standing presence in the market, the business has operated for multiple decades, highlighting experience in supplying cleaning solutions to public and quasi-public entities. Positioned as a significant supplier within its industry, Twi-Laq Industries emphasizes its role in providing cleaning supplies to sizable municipal and educational accounts. The company is located in New York and is described as one of the larger providers in its field, reflecting a reliance on institutional customers and long-term relationships to support its operations. ## Twi-Laq Industries Global Highlights.
